title: How Do Coding-Agent Harnesses Self-Evolve? An Empirical Study of Retrospective Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34938v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents can adapt their harnesses, the software, configuration, and instructions used to run them, based on experience from earlier tasks, but whether these adaptations improve their behavior on later tasks remains unclear. We study \retro, a skill that asks an agent to review a completed session and propose harness changes, and ask what changes it proposes and whether implemented changes reduce repeated work on later tasks. We ran Claude Code on 30 SWE-bench Verified issues, qualitatively coded the 125 proposals from \retro, implemented 24, and evaluated 12 harness changes on later issues from the same repositories in fresh sessions with and without each change. Most proposals referred to an event in the session, but 18 of 43 lint-related proposals recommended a practice regardless of what had happened. translated_title: 编码智能体运行框架如何自我进化？一项关于回溯性适应的实证研究
translated_abstract: 编码智能体可以根据早期任务的经验调整其运行框架（即用于运行它们的软件、配置和指令），但这些调整能否改善其在后续任务中的表现仍不清楚。我们研究了 Retro，这是一项要求智能体回顾已完成的会话并提出框架更改建议的技能，并探究它会提出哪些更改，以及实施这些更改是否能减少后续任务中的重复工作。我们在 30 个 SWE-bench Verified 问题上运行了 Claude Code，对 Retro 提出的 125 条建议进行了定性编码，实施了其中 24 条，并在来自相同代码仓库的后续问题上，分别在有和无每项更改的全新会话中评估了 12 项框架更改。大多数建议都与会话中的某个事件相关，但在 43 条与 lint 相关的建议中，有 18 条无论实际发生了什么都推荐某种做法。在未应用更改的会话确实遇到目标问题的七项评估中，有两项更改消除了该重复问题（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次实证研究了编码智能体通过回顾已完成任务会话来提出并实施运行框架改进的“回溯性适应”机制，发现尽管大多数建议源于具体会话事件，但在七项有效评估中仅有两项更改真正消除了后续任务中的目标问题，表明自我进化的实际收益仍然有限。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study of retrospective adaptation in coding agents—where the Retro skill reviews completed sessions to propose and implement harness changes—and finds that although most proposals stem from specific session events, only two of seven evaluated changes actually eliminated the targeted repeated problems in later tasks.
